rationale: Every near-term date Grok liked (Sept 28-29, Oct 2, Oct 5) passed with no filing, no special committee and no banker leaks; ~80% of $25B+ deals leak first, so a signed deal in the next week looks unlikely. Against that: Tesla still has no 2026 meeting date with a ~Dec 6 Texas deadline, won SEC approval for a retail auto-vote-with-board program (Sept 29), and set up $30B of credit lines. The Roadster demo moved to Oct 15 and Q3 earnings are Oct 21, so the cleanest near-term slots are Oct 16-19 (post-Roadster) or with/after the Q3 print. My read is that the AGM silence is more likely a delay/comp item than a held merger ballot until proven otherwise, and that a deal, if it comes, more likely targets a 2027 special meeting after SPCX's big Nov/Dec unlocks clear. Roughly in line with Polymarket (14% by Dec 31, 45% by Jun 30 2027), slightly below Kalshi's 'definitive agreement' curve in spring 2027.
